[To [Wilhelmina Martha James](/person/754)]It is coming, but there were so many that we are obliged to send them to the post by instalments

C M Yonge


[^1]: A printed postcard, addressed on reverse to ‘Miss W M James/ Clarghyll Hall/ Alston/ Carlisle’ and postmarked 23 July 1873.

James was a novelist, who contributed a story called \'Coin of the Realm\' to the MP Christmas number of 1874 under her usual pseudonym \'Austin Clare\'.

However, this enigmatic message does not seem to relate to that.
